name: Feed-Backward Reconstruction
definition: A reconstruction method that views convolution as gathering contributions from neighboring input samples for each output sample. It calculates each output value individually by centering the reconstruction kernel at the output sample and computing a weighted average of input samples lying under the kernel.
summary: Feed-Backward Reconstruction resamples discrete data by gathering weighted input contributions for each output, differing from feed-forward by accessing each input multiple times to avoid large buffer initialization overhead.
